steps.speaker: Captured Gangster
steps.content: I'm telling the truth. I don't know any arms dealers. Those Mania weapons came to us from various channels. I really don't know who they were!

steps.speaker: Captured Sheriff
steps.content: Oh, right... Well, we'll round up the Legion after killing you. The director's order is for us to take back the inheritance, and... kill the Legion Sinner who escaped from the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Captured Sheriff
steps.content: The director tried to tweak some information, to manipulate that <color=#fb9259>new MBCC Chief</color> into taking care of the whole thing. But the new Chief wasn't much of an order follower...

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Zoya's footsteps approach (Portrait, Fading in)

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I know there's someone behind the Mania weapons; I also know the Public Security Bureau has a connection with them. Your subordinate has given us quite a lot of information, and there will be no reinforcements for you for the time being.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Stop beating around the bush, Burns; my patience is running thin.

steps.speaker: (Subtitles)
steps.content: 10:02 Conference hall

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Well... at this point, I guess it won't hurt to tell you the truth.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Over a decade ago, the gangs here were out of control; many gangsters attempted to cross the Rust to attack the Eastside. I was the Chief of the local security precinct back then. An order from the Public Security Bureau arrived at my desk, which instructed me to purge this place, "at all costs."

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: The order came with a man who called himself an <color=#fb9259>arms dealer</color>. He said he could make my troubles go away.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: The arms dealer controlled the supply of weapons to the various gangs; he could help me build a balance of power among the gangs, and he would be able to keep the Syndicans in the West District, so that they wouldn't cause troubles in the Eastside.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: He made good on his promises. More importantly, he wants nothing but money. He won't try to build up his power base and take over Syndicate; he's also promised to always stay behind the scene and get involved only when I need him to.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: The problems of the West District can finally be solved... finally...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...His solution was to string the gangsters along with the promise of making them the overlords of Syndicate, then incite violence to drive up the price of arms.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You, on the other hand, can control Syndicate at a low cost with the help of the arms dealer. You don't care about the lives of ordinary people anyway...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Well, it's you and the arms dealer who are the real master of Syndicate, not those short-lived overlords.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Is the spreading of <color=#fb9259>Mania weapons</color> part of your plan too?

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: I'll handle it... I'll be able to...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Who are these people? Where are they? What do they want?
After a long silence, Burns bursts into laughter, a faintly twisted kind of laughter.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Haha... I could tell you all that, but what would you do when you find them?

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Zoya, for all this time, you've been chasing new enemies...

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: First the gangs, then the Mania peddlers... What next? The Public Security Bureau? The Eastside? The entire city? You really think your Syndicate will be all the better if you eradicate them all?

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Hell no. All you do is <color=#fb9259>wreak destruction</color>. You can't bring any real change.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Don't give me that crap. Answer my questions.
Zoya seizes hold of his collar, but he seems to be in a stupor. He continues laughing; his listless laughter sounds both like taunts directed at Zoya and like whispers addressed to himself.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: You're not the savior of Syndicate. Your power is the only source of your confidence, and you have nothing but that violent power of yours.

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: You can't defeat him... The stronger you get, the more you are doomed to failure... Sinner, you... can't defeat... yourself...

steps.speaker: Burns
steps.content: Ah!!
His eyes widen in horror, and his body swells up and contorts into a mass of filth. Zoya leaps backwards, narrowly avoiding the blast just as the mass of filth explodes.
In the wake of the explosion, a man clad in black rises to his feet, one hand holding a briefcase, the other holding an umbrella to shield himself from the raining drops of filth.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...You're the man behind him.
Yes. Syndicate has a new master. I've come to present a congratulations gift.
As he raises the briefcase, a familiar sickening sensation washes over. Before he can open it, Zoya makes a beeline for him and punches through his torso.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I won't let you get your way.
Oh... That's the spirit. Treat me as an enemy...
The man dissolves like ink. The briefcase dissolves too, revealing a black cube.
The cube explodes and spawns numerous spikes that penetrate Zoya's chest.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Ugh! Is this... the inheritance?
Exactly... And more than one of them. Syndicate deserves more. You... deserve more.
Fight, Zoya, fight with your true form... It's always been you that <color=#fb9259>they</color> desire...
...Ugh!
What follows is a turbulent wail coming from the depths of your soul. In an instant, the mental contamination swallows you up like a tidal wave. But you know that you're not the one under attack.
At the other end of the shackles, someone's consciousness has been torn into shreds. You're fully aware of this as you are being dragged into the abyss too.

10:42 A large-scale contamination incident breaks out in Keylan Square. 
Mania crisis level: S+
, M value in the area approaching the threshold level for a Black Ring.
